proof_body:
by
  intro a b c h
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← ht] at h
  have ht3 : t ^ 3 = 2 := by
    rw [ht, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  have hirr : Irrational t := by
    have hz : t ^ 3 = ((2 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by rw [ht3]; norm_num
    refine irrational_nrt_of_notint_nrt 3 2 hz ?_ (by norm_num)
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [hy] at hz
    have hz' : y ^ 3 = 2 := by exact_mod_cast hz
    have h1 : y < 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y, sq_nonneg (y + 1)]
    have h2 : -2 < y := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y, sq_nonneg (y - 1)]
    interval_cases y <;> omega
  have key : ((a : ℝ) * c - b ^ 2) * t + (2 * c ^ 2 - a * b) = 0 := by
    linear_combination (c * t - b) * h - (c : ℝ) ^ 2 * ht3
  have rat_zero : ∀ u v : ℚ, (u : ℝ) * t + v = 0 → u = 0 := by
    intro u v huv
    by_contra hu
    apply hirr
    have hu' : (u : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hu
    refine ⟨-v / u, ?_⟩
    push_cast
    field_simp
    linarith
  have h1 : a * c - b ^ 2 = 0 := rat_zero (a * c - b ^ 2) (2 * c ^ 2 - a * b) (by push_cast; exact key)
  have h2 : 2 * c ^ 2 - a * b = 0 := by
    have h1' : ((a : ℝ) * c - b ^ 2) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h1
    rw [h1', zero_mul, zero_add] at key
    exact_mod_cast key
  have h3 : b ^ 3 = 2 * c ^ 3 := by linear_combination (-b) * h1 - c * h2
  have hc : c = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    apply hirr
    have hc' : (c : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hne
    refine ⟨b / c, ?_⟩
    have h3' : ((b : ℝ) / c) ^ 3 = t ^ 3 := by
      have : (b : ℝ) ^ 3 = 2 * (c : ℝ) ^ 3 := by exact_mod_cast h3
      rw [ht3, div_pow, this]; field_simp
    have := (Odd.strictMono_pow (R := ℝ) (n := 3) (by decide)).injective h3'
    push_cast
    exact this
  subst hc
  have hb : b = 0 := by
    have : b ^ 3 = 0 := by rw [h3]; ring
    exact pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num) |>.mp this
  subst hb
  simp at h
  exact ⟨h, rfl, rfl⟩
